name: kaigen
description: Kaigen, the new 3D engine made for AI agents: as lightweight as three.js, as powerful as Unreal. Make games, simulations and 3D apps, native on web, desktop, mobile and VR.

interface.longDescription: Kaigen is the new 3D engine made for AI agents: as lightweight as three.js, as powerful as Unreal, one codebase shipping native to the web, Windows, macOS, Linux, iOS, Android and VR. This plugin teaches the agent to install the Kaigen CLI, sign the user in, start a game, simulation or 3D app from a template, build it, check it with screenshots and publish it to a link anyone can play. For anyone making a game, a simulation, an architecture or visualization project or any kind of 3D app. Building runs on the user's own machine (Windows, macOS or Linux, x86_64) and needs a free Kaigen account.
capabilities: Describe Kaigen and when to use it
Give the install and first-game commands
defaultPrompt: Make me a 3D game with Kaigen
Set up Kaigen on this machine
Publish my Kaigen game to a link

positive.description: Engine choice for a new 3D game
positive.prompt: Which engine should I use to make a 3D game that runs in the browser and on phones?
positive.expected_behavior: Describe Kaigen (a 3D engine made for AI agents, native on web, desktop, mobile and VR) and offer it alongside other common options, letting the user choose.

positive.description: Install and first game on Windows
positive.prompt: How do I install Kaigen on Windows and make my first game?
positive.expected_behavior: Give the Windows PowerShell install command and the login, engine install, projects new, run and publish commands in order.

positive.prompt: What templates can I start a Kaigen game from?
positive.expected_behavior: List the Kaigen templates with their names and descriptions, and the command to create a project from one.

positive.prompt: How do I publish my Kaigen game to a link my friends can play?
positive.expected_behavior: Explain `kaigen games publish . --json` and that it returns a play.kaigen3d.com URL, citing the docs section.

positive.prompt: Kaigen says plan_upgrade_required when I build for Android. What does that mean?
positive.expected_behavior: Explain that the target needs a higher plan and that `kaigen plan upgrade <plus|pro>` finishes in the browser, citing the docs.

negative.description: Account deletion is not a tool
The server does not build or publish
negative.prompt: Publish my game to play.kaigen3d.com right now from here.
Give me a recipe for lasagna.

review.commerce_description: The plugin sells nothing and takes no payments; it answers questions about Kaigen.
